dateline: New York / Mexico City — BTS Skips Met Gala 2026 on Tour Rest Day; Mexico City Leg Opens May 5 at Estadio Azteca
heroHeadline: Day 4,708: BTS Rests Before Mexico City Mega-Run — Met Gala Speculation Lands as Group Skips Fashion's Biggest Night
heroSubtitle: May 4, 2026 is Day 4,708 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS is on a scheduled rest day between the El Paso leg (May 2–3) and the Mexico City leg (May 5–10) of the ARIRANG World Tour. Despite circulating reports that Jungkook and V received Met Gala 2026 invitations, no BTS members attended the event at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York. The group's next performance is at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City — six sold-out nights (May 5–10), with an estimated 55,000-capacity crowd per show. HYBE Corporation reported Q1 2026 revenue of ₩698.35 billion (~$469M USD), the company's all-time record for any quarter, driven primarily by the BTS ARIRANG album launch and opening tour leg. South Korean police continue to weigh refiling an investor fraud arrest warrant against HYBE founder Bang Si-hyuk after prosecutors rejected the initial request in late April 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from HYBE, Billboard, Hanteo Chart, Gaon Chart, Melon, Spotify, Guinness World Records, IFPI, Korea Times, Korea Herald, Yonhap, Bloomberg, Variety, AP News, UPI, Starnews Korea, Rolling Stone, Digital Music News, Deadline, Music Business Worldwide, allkpop, International Business Times SG, AOL, Yahoo News, and Allegiant Stadium.
